repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR requires a 1-minute sustain window for `Presence == false`. The candidate uses a 1000 ms wrapper period and a threshold of 60. At 1000 ms intervals, 60 ticks cover only 60 seconds (60,000 ms). The IR specifies `1 MIN` (60,000 ms), but the JoI execution contract counts ticks starting at t=0. To sustain for 60 seconds on a 1-second grid, the condition must remain true for 60 full intervals *after* the initial check, requiring a threshold of 61 (covering t=0 through t=60000). The evidence shows the action firing at 59000 ms (59 seconds), one second too early.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed the threshold from 60 to 61 to correctly account for the initial tick at t=0, ensuring the action fires exactly at 60 seconds (60000 ms) rather than 59 seconds. Also explicitly set `period` to 1000 to match the 1-second granularity implied by the threshold calculation.
